Two workers standing side by side. On the left, a farmer in simple work clothes holding a hoe, with crops behind him. On the right, a professional in a smart suit holding a briefcase, with a modern office building behind him. Both have calm, dignified expressions and are standing on the exact same ground level, illustrating that both manual and office work carry equal personal dignity. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A sequence illustration in two panels. Panel 1 (left): Early morning in a biblical marketplace. A wealthy landowner (householder) is shaking hands with a group of workers, agreeing on a wage. Panel 2 (right): Evening time. The householder stands by his steward, who is handing a single silver coin (a denarius/penny) to a worker who arrived late, while the workers who arrived early look on with surprised and slightly unhappy expressions.

A scene inside a basic first-century workshop. Paul, dressed in simple ancient robes, is sitting on a low stool and stitching a large piece of heavy canvas/leather to make a tent. He looks focused and tired, but determined. Next to him is a completed tent section. A subtle ray of light highlights his honest manual labour, illustrating II Thessalonians 3:8.
